Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an indication for chronic kidney disease. Join drug_indication on molregno to molecule_dictionary and INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter where mesh_heading or efo_term matches 'chronic kidney disease'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
